newsitem.title: USA: US West Coast gasoline prices flat late Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: US West Coast gasoline prices flat late Wednesday.

text.p: U.S. West Coast spot product prices were unchanged in slow Wednesday discussion, with buying expected to revive late this week amid pipeline scheduling deadlines, brokers said.
West Coast refiners must buy gasoline before they begin shipping the product across Santa Fe Pipeline for early March delivery .
Traders said supply appeared tighter after Tuesday's API report, which showed West Coast gasoline inventories down 554,000 barrels to 28.8 million barrels last week.
CARB-grade gasoline remained 73/74 cents a gallon, even with Tuesday levels, while conventional grade in L.A. held at 68/68.50 cents.
